rules.when: The task requires GENERATING IMAGES: creating, rendering, or producing image files.
rules.why: Use the requested Codex image-generation profile when producing image files.

rules.when: The task is technical, product design, architecture, or planning work that is genuinely VERY difficult.
rules.why: Keep the strongest reasoning options available; quota-axi selects the feasible candidate and preserves an exceptional Astra fallback.

rules.when: The task is a simple bug fix whose root cause and expected behavior are already well defined.
rules.why: Use efficient models for well-defined work while letting current quota decide between the two profiles.
